subtitle.en: A private residence shaped by light, silence and intelligent comfort.

intro.en: M1558 is not defined by the number of rooms, but by the way Madrid is held at a distance — through light, quiet interiors and a terrace that opens the home to the city.

experiences.en: Floor-to-ceiling windows, inner patios and a calm that changes throughout the day.
Aerothermal climate, underfloor heating and home automation — technology without theatre.
A private edge above Goya. The city remains close, but never intrusive.

conciergeIntro.en: I am the private digital advisor for M1558. Ask me about the residence, its spaces or Goya.

sequences.en: The residence wakes slowly. Light enters through the windows and patios, turning the private interior into a changing composition.
The city remains close, but the home creates a deliberate distance: a quiet interior above the rhythm of Goya.
The terrace becomes the final room of the day. Madrid is no longer the destination; it is the view.
Comfort becomes invisible. The house closes around you, while the city continues outside.

en: The private core sits away from the city while the living axis opens gradually toward the terrace.
The living axis connects the spaces used throughout the day.
The city edge is where the residence becomes a viewpoint.
es: El núcleo privado se mantiene alejado de la ciudad mientras el eje de vida se abre hacia la terraza.
El eje de vida conecta los espacios que se utilizan durante el día.
El borde de la ciudad convierte la residencia en un punto de observación.

intro.en: A home defined by light, calm and intelligent comfort — a private interior that keeps the city close without letting it take over.

note.en: Light does not decorate this home — it organises it. It arrives through the patios at dawn, crosses the living axis through the day, and takes its leave from the terrace.
note.es: La luz no decora esta casa: la organiza. Entra por los patios al amanecer, cruza el eje de vida durante el día y se despide desde la terraza.

note.en: Salamanca stays outside. Within these walls the city becomes a distant sound — close enough to belong to it, far enough to forget it.
note.es: Salamanca se queda fuera. Dentro, la ciudad se convierte en un sonido lejano: lo bastante cerca para pertenecer a ella, lo bastante lejos para olvidarla.

note.en: Nothing here asks to be admired. Proportion, material and silence do the work, and then step back.
note.es: Nada aquí pide ser admirado. La proporción, el material y el silencio hacen el trabajo y después se retiran.

note.en: Aerothermal climate, underfloor heating, automation. You will never once think about any of it — which is precisely the point.
note.es: Aerotermia, suelo radiante, domótica. No pensarás en nada de ello ni una sola vez, y ese es exactamente el objetivo.

note.en: Retiro before breakfast, Serrano at midday, the Prado on an ordinary Thursday. An address that removes the distance between wanting and going.
note.es: El Retiro antes de desayunar, Serrano a mediodía, el Prado un jueves cualquiera. Una dirección que elimina la distancia entre querer e ir.

intro.en: Goya is not presented as a pin on a map, but as a rhythm of culture, dining, movement and private city life.

line.en: Retiro and the city waking around you
The restaurants and galleries of Salamanca
A residence above Madrid’s urban rhythm
A central address with the city close

identityNote.en: The experience begins at the threshold between the city and the private interior.
identityNote.es: La experiencia comienza en el umbral entre la ciudad y el interior privado.

sequenceTitle.en: The city, held at a distance.

sequenceIntro.en: A residence is understood not by its room list, but by the way it changes as the day moves through it.
sequenceIntro.es: Una residencia se entiende no por su lista de habitaciones, sino por cómo cambia a medida que el día la recorre.

spatialTitle.en: A residence with a quiet logic.
spatialTitle.es: Una residencia con una lógica silenciosa.

spatialIntro.en: The important thing is not only what each room contains, but how the private core, living axis and city edge relate to one another.
spatialIntro.es: Lo importante no es solo lo que contiene cada estancia, sino cómo se relacionan el núcleo privado, el eje de vida y el borde de la ciudad.

spatialDetail.en: The private core sits away from the city while the living axis opens gradually toward the terrace.
spatialDetail.es: El núcleo privado se sitúa alejado de la ciudad mientras el eje de vida se abre gradualmente hacia la terraza.

detailsIntro.en: Every detail is designed to make comfort feel effortless — from the material palette to the systems that remain invisible until they are needed.
detailsIntro.es: Cada detalle está diseñado para que el confort resulte effortless — desde la paleta de materiales hasta los sistemas que permanecen invisibles hasta que se necesitan.

en: Before the residence is revealed, the city falls behind.
The experience begins at the passage between noise and calm.
Light does not decorate this home. It organises it.
Patios, windows and silence shape the rhythm of Goya.
A private, intelligent residence open to Madrid.
Now you can explore how it lives.
es: Antes de descubrir la vivienda, la ciudad queda detrás.
La experiencia empieza en el paso entre el ruido y la calma.
La luz no decora este hogar. Lo organiza.
Patios, ventanales y silencio construyen el ritmo de Goya.
Una residencia privada, inteligente y abierta a Madrid.
Ahora puedes explorar cómo se vive aquí.
